:::{#def-empirical-risk}
#### Empirical risk

The **empirical risk** of a [fitted model](#def-fitted-model) $\fitted$
on a set of $\nobs$ observations
is the [sample mean](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-sample-mean)
of its [loss](#def-observation-loss) on those observations,
the sample analogue of the [risk](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-risk),
which is the expected loss:

$$
\epoprisk\paren{\fitted} \eqdef \frac{1}{\nobs} \sumin \obsloss{\iobs}\paren{\fitted}.
$$ {#eq-empirical-risk}

A subscript names the set the empirical risk is evaluated on,
as in $\epoprisk_{\trainset}$ for a [training set](#def-training-set) $\trainset$.

:::
